jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, AI Solutions Strategy & Planning based in Canada.

We are seeking a strategic and forward-thinking AI leader to shape the planning, development, and adoption of AI-powered solutions across a dynamic business environment. In this leadership role, you will connect business priorities with emerging AI capabilities, helping teams identify opportunities that deliver measurable value and operational impact. You will guide strategic planning, align cross-functional stakeholders, and establish clear roadmaps for AI initiatives. The role requires balancing innovation with practical execution, ensuring solutions support organizational goals and evolving customer needs. You will work in a flexible, collaborative environment that values diverse perspectives, experimentation, and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to influence AI strategy at a senior level and help turn emerging technologies into meaningful business outcomes.

Accountabilities

Define and lead AI solutions strategy and planning, aligning initiatives with business objectives, operational priorities, and long-term organizational goals.
Identify opportunities to apply AI across business functions, evaluating potential use cases, feasibility, expected value, and implementation requirements.
Develop strategic roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, and execution plans for AI initiatives, ensuring resources are directed toward high-impact opportunities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders to translate business challenges into actionable AI strategies and scalable solutions.
Establish governance, performance measurement, and success criteria to assess the effectiveness and business impact of AI initiatives.
Support the evaluation and adoption of emerging AI technologies, balancing innovation, scalability, risk, and practical business needs.
Facilitate alignment between technical teams and business leaders to ensure AI solutions address real-world requirements and deliver measurable outcomes.
Monitor industry trends, evolving AI capabilities, and best practices to identify opportunities for continuous innovation and strategic improvement.
Promote responsible AI adoption, encouraging thoughtful implementation, effective collaboration, and alignment with organizational standards.

Requirements

The provided source does not specify formal minimum qualifications for this position. The following capabilities are relevant to the role's stated strategic focus.
Demonstrated experience in AI strategy, technology planning, digital transformation, product strategy, or a related leadership discipline.
Ability to translate business objectives into AI opportunities, strategic roadmaps, and actionable implementation plans.
Strong understanding of AI technologies and their potential applications in business environments.
Experience evaluating initiatives based on business value, feasibility, scalability, and measurable outcomes.
Proven ability to work across functions and influence senior stakeholders, aligning business priorities with technical execution.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex and evolving technology landscapes.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and strategic recommendations to diverse audiences.
Ability to lead planning processes, manage competing priorities, and foster collaboration in a flexible, fast-moving environment.
Commitment to responsible innovation, continuous learning, and inclusive teamwork.

Benefits

Flexible work arrangements, with opportunities for in-office, flex, or remote work depending on the position and applicable arrangements.
An inclusive workplace that values diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and professional experiences.
Accessibility and accommodation support throughout the recruitment process.
Additional compensation, healthcare, retirement, leave, and other benefits were not specified in the provided source.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
